description: Connects a sending subdomain (for example news.example.com) to Morada.ai email campaigns: DKIM signing, bounce handling, DMARC policy and branded tracking links. All records are CNAMEs that point into the morada-ai.email zone managed by Morada.ai.
variableDescription: selector: the DKIM selector issued by Morada.ai (for example morada1). code: the per-domain code issued by Morada.ai that scopes the DKIM, bounce and DMARC targets. The sending subdomain (for example news) is passed through the host parameter.
